Jang Pung 3.name: Jang Pung 3
Jang Pung 3.summary: The world's greatest fighters gather together to stop a Nazi cyborg dinosaur. Original content sequel to the Street Fighter II bootleg "Jang Pung II".

Wonder Boy.name: Wonder Boy
Wonder Boy.summary: Wonder Boy was ported to the Sega Mark III/Master System video game console by Sega. The game is also known as Super Wonder Boy for its Sega Mark III release in Japan.
